author: TeIq
content: PR 6 landed. classifier/feedback.rs delivers build_feedback() with privacy boundary at the signature, action_kind_wire_string() with explicit Reverse→no_action mapping, spawn_feedback() fire-and-forget delivery. 4 new tests (28 classifier-module tests total). AC-7 covered: prost-encoded wire form contains no moderator_id / audit_chain / reporter_did / exposure / reasoning substrings. Wiring the send_feedback config flag into cases::submit_action is a thin glue change tracked as part of #131 (sample classifier + docs) so operators have a runnable end-to-end demo.
